description: This PHP class 'AdministratorAccessSubscriber' subscribes to Symfony kernel controller events. It checks the type of controller being invoked and adjusts user privileges accordingly, specifically setting admin access flags based on controller type.

classes.name: AdministratorAccessSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber for Symfony kernel controller events that manages user admin access privileges based on the controller being invoked.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to, notably the kernel controller event.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles the controller event to adjust user admin access privileges depending on the controller type.
